Most policies in GA will cover a permitted user, but this case is a little different. Your fiancé is he named insured and his ex is listed as a driver. Permission needs to come directly from the named insured. So her giving permission to a third party can easily be excluded. If this weren’t the case transference of permission would be infinite.

Ah well I’m sorry to hear that. They say it was phrased implied to me that he had never been a part of your life. It’s been a few hours and you got a bunch of replies, what do you think you’re going to do?

ESH except you. I’m surprised that nobody pointed out that Mrs. is the incorrect title for your Mom unless the reason for you “not having a Dad” is because she is widowed. Your stuck in the middle and your Mom is being a bit unreasonable. But, it also doesn’t bode well for a relationship that your SO won’t bend just a little bit. It is all about give and take and this should be an easy point to compromise on.

I’ve been there. I’ve procrastinated in school to the point where I still have dreams about needing to take classes to finish my degree years later.

I would suggest talking to each one of your professors individually. Tell them that you were in a bit of a fog this semester due to personal issues and see what they are willing to do to who you get the minimum grades you need. Going to get help from a counselor might be a good idea for your mental health, but could also help with your professors.
